info.title: Create Guid
info.description: A command-line utility to help developers create GUIDs and UUIDs for their projects in various output formats, copy to clipboard, and save to output file.\nRun create-guid in your favorite console window.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Default command that generates GUIDs in the appropriate format

options.name: --help
options.description:
Prints help information
operation: q(uiet),
m(inimal), n(ormal),

options.name: --verbosity
options.description:
Normal     The verbosity level for this
operation: q(uiet),
m(inimal), n(ormal),
d(etailed), and diag(nostic)

options.name: --count
options.description:
1          The number of GUIDs to
generate (defaults to 1)

options.name: --format
options.description:
Default    Defines how the GUIDs are
formatted in string form
(Default, Number, Braces,
Parens, Hex)

options.name: --uuid-v7
options.description:
Generates a UUID v7
compliant GUID for sortable
unique identifiers

options.name: --empty
options.description:
Defines if the GUIDs should
be empty (using zero-values)

options.name: --upper
options.description:
Defines if the generated
GUIDs should be upper-cased
(defaults to lower-cased)

options.name: --clipboard-copy
options.description:
Defines whether the output
of this command should be
copied to the system
clipboard

options.name: --output
options.description:
Filename for output file
used to save generated guids
